purpose: Reference only. Runtime pixels were manually authored in a new live Aseprite document, never resized or quantized from the concept.

reference.prompt: Create a pixel-art design reference of a small jade-green stochastic parrot holding a closed paper dictionary under its wing. Side view facing left, golden hooked beak, short angular tail, exactly two bird feet, upper-left light, selective dark outline. A warm retro Chinese clockwork library game character, not a humanoid. Four equal panels in one horizontal row, no visible dividers: idle; a tiny breathing bob with planted feet; anticipation lifting the same book; recovery lowering it. Same character scale and baseline in every panel. Target for later manual Aseprite interpretation: 48x48 canvas, about 28px tall subject. Palette for subject: #0f191b #2c2330 #24423b #426b50 #8fa86b #b9905d #e5c386 #f5e8c8 #cbb696 #9dded1. Plain neutral grey background. Hard chunky pixel clusters. No gradients, text, book lettering, labels, numbers, scenery, motion lines, watermark or cropped body parts. Never use the protagonist orange #D97757. This output is reference only, not a production sprite sheet.
reference.status: Imported panel-by-panel as a guide; not shipped as a runtime texture. Original Clawd reference unchanged.
